## Select a language

These fences exercise the code tabs rendered by the documentation shell.

```python
print("first group")
```

```rust
fn main() { println!("first group"); }
```

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("first group") }
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>

int main() {
    std::cout << "first group\n";
}
```

## Keep the language while reading

```python
print("second group")
```

```rust
fn main() { println!("second group"); }
```

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("second group") }
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>

int main() {
    std::cout << "second group\n";
}
```
